rule.def: Can activate 4 Supplies at the same time

off.t: Legends say this was a racetrack made of crystal long ago. Though utterly damaged, it still attracts a large crowd of unruly sprinters today.
Drunks crossing the road, low-altitude pilots hovering without permission... Why do they all seem to be picking up speed?
With the inconsistent rise and fall of the waves and unceasingly increasing level of danger, one ought to act as soon as possible.
'No one expects you to never make mistakes, but I hope you can swiftly correct any mistakes you make.'

boss.d:
[Self-Defense Arts] Periodically gains a shield that protects against Physical and Arts damage, which is broken after taking a certain number of attacks
[Concentration Algorithm] Locks onto a target and bombards it, dealing Physical damage to it and the surrounding units several times
[Organically Linked Formula] Fights in concert with

off.t: Endless flames, restless ghosts. An eternal chase.
Stones from other hills can polish jade. Fire the jade twice to form a crimson glaze, but be careful—they're fragile.
Both stove and stock are ready, and uninvited guests have to be cleared first—but have some juice before you continue.
'You've faced situations more complex than this one—how? Did you break them down into smaller problems, then tackle them one by one? Have you found the key to flipping the table of this battle?'

boss.d:
[Nirvana Program] While regenerating, locks onto the target with the highest Block and attacks them every few seconds, reducing their max Block
[Engineering Meteor Shower] In second form, when is blocked, locks onto the blocking Operator and attacks them, lowering their Block Count

off.t: The surging tides wash away the sandcastles, and the builders begin to flood the beach with their anger.
It is not the sparks of fireworks hitting your body, but it still stings.
Volcanoes may be right beside you, but pay attention to the tide coming in too.

'Sometimes, the courage to persevere comes from knowing a solution already exists. But what if that was no longer a possibility? Would you keep at it still? Before you challenge me, first prove to yourself that the possibility still exists. This is not a step to be omitted.'

boss.d: In second form, activates [Nirvana Program] again when HP drops below 50% for the first time

hard.t: Inhaling too much smoke on the battlefield is detrimental to one's health.
The original plan was to have everyone drive here, but some of the simulation sources were drunk during recording, so they all came walking instead.
If memories flood back into the mind, if emotions are once again hard to bear...
'Yes, this is the end. You may try to proceed, but I can no longer make you any guarantees.'

off.t: While collectors are scared of their collections getting stolen, it's the rough way that the brutish thieves will treat the invaluable pieces that truly frightens them.
No matter which side of the battlefield you are fighting for, the black of night will leave your nerves on edge. The tension reaches every corner of your body.
When walking along this road, people can never predict what might emerge from the blind spot just around the next bend.
'It is unwise to focus all your attention on any one thing, especially when visibility is limited. The more you concentrate on what you can see, the more you expose your weak points.'

boss.d:
100% Physical and Arts Dodge when on a tile shrouded by night
[Instant Scar] Deals heavy Physical damage to the Operator with the lowest Max HP; targets defeated this way have greatly increased Redeployment Time; target loses visibility if hit 3 times in a row.
[Dissolution Space] When affected by Stun, Cold, Freeze, Fear, Lure, or Shifted, immediately removes the condition, recovers some HP, and becomes immune to these effects for several seconds.

off.t: No way forward, no way back. Not for me, nor my enemy. Which is why I don't hesitate.
The flames seem brighter than usual when contrasted against the night, but they cannot dispel the darkness, let alone reveal the dangers still hiding within.
Their instinct calls for growth, their mission propagation. Wheresoever the light touches, hunger swallows all rationality.
'Remember, when some of your senses aren't working, don't let your guard down just because of a moment of quiet. The illusions created by witchcraft are often fatal.'

boss.d: When defeated for the first time, returns to the field and changes behavior: When entering the visibility of allies, immediately moves to a tile shrouded by night and stops moving (no allies in path); continues moving after casting [Instant Scar], or if he does not find a target.

off.t: Simply knowing the way to the exit won't save you in this maneuver. Take a look at the horde of enemies surging towards the narrow path and rethink your plan.
Even an ambush from the darkest shadows creates sound. It's just that the environment rarely lets the target notice these warning signs.
Everyone has times they want to be alone.
'Even the slimmest of gaps can be torn open, becoming a path leading people to despair. Once you step into the darkness, be mindful of everything you do.'

boss.d: [Diffuse Fission] Attacks and [Instant Scar] deal continuous Arts damage, and targets that leave the field while effect is active have greatly increased Redeployment Time.

hard.t: A word of warning: that math question earlier has more than one solution. Don't overlook any of them.
This stretch of road is famous for its high accident rate. If you really must know, the major factors are poor lighting, heavier-than-expected usage, and many people's poor driving skills.
Even the most perfectly designed structure necessarily has a load-bearing feature. Finding this weak point may be difficult, but he welcomes you to try.
'Completing your objective is worth celebrating, but the next night will be even darker. You'd better consider how you're going to handle it.'

off.t: Everyone who comes here is convinced that the next floor of the spiral corridor is the exit. But the truth is rarely what they think.
Even through a medium that seems indestructible, energy waves keep spreading.
Do not block the middle of the track. This rule isn't only to keep the race running smoothly; it's also for your own safety.
"Muscles that suddenly lose their strength, nerves that can no longer carry a signal, and the despair that follows. Do not let them defeat you."

boss.d:
Attacks inflict Frenzy
[Receptor Overreaction] Channels continuously, increasing all other enemies' Movement Speed and restoring their HP every few seconds; when the channel succeeds, all other enemies require +1 Block for several seconds. The channel can be interrupted
[Endogenous Compensation] Movement Speed cannot drop below its initial value; reduced duration of resistible negative statuses, reduced further if afflicted by the same status again within a few seconds

off.t: For some, rust and lubricant are enough to compose a spectacular musical.
A place that brings hope can also create the deepest panic. So it is with everything in this world.
Pain becomes the strength that drives one forward. When the time is right, those flowers will bloom again upon the ruins.
"Necrosis born from within is just like a blade from without. You must stay alert and respond accordingly."

boss.d:
Periodically selects 1 allied Operator and creates <Active Agitation> on its tile and the 4 surrounding tiles; revives upon first defeat, then creates <Active Agitation> on all Operators and their 4 surrounding tiles
[Acute Myelinolysis] Summons 1 special <'Hyperperfusion'> that moves toward itself; on contact, absorbs it and explodes, dealing heavy Arts damage to all allied units

off.t: You might wonder whether this is some kind of special arrangement, but don't overthink it. Someone just forgot to turn off the tap.
The director's demands are vague, the script is truly bizarre, and now they want improvisation too. If something goes wrong, don't come crying.
A pungent smell fills the air, and common sense and experience tell you that such a smell is rarely a good sign.
"Even the tiniest physiological structure can deal a fatal wound when attacked. Never let your guard down."

boss.d: Each time 'Touch', Flow of Regeneration is afflicted by 1 type of negative status, all <'Hyperperfusion'> become immune to it

hard.t: One of an explorer's greatest worries is finally discovering a hidden realm, only to find footprints already on the ground.
City rules have long stated that anyone occupying a dedicated lane will be severely punished. Sadly, some people just have little regard for the law.
The more dazzling the lights outside, the darker the unlit places seem. Even a cute mascot placed backstage can scare the living daylights out of you.
"You've already made it through the hardest part. Things are slowly getting better, so please don't let go of the hope you hold in your heart..."
